title: “I mean, I’ve heard of artists dropping a surprise album, but Avril Lavigne dropping a surprise baby is taking it to the next level."
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to Homepage Avril Lavigne is a mom! Canadian singer shares photos of her 'mini princess' as fans praise the 'amazing news'
 The 42-year-old singer returned to social media after more than a year to share the happy news with fans. 
 Elizabeth Di Filippo Fri, November 13, 2026 at 4:59 p.m. UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Avril Lavigne has announced the arrival of her first child. (Getty Images) Avril Lavigne is a first-time mom! On Friday, the 42-year-old singer took to Instagram to announce the arrival of her first child, a daughter.
 The singer shared a triptych of black and white photos to Instagram with the caption, "Our mini f—king princess has arrived" — a reference to the lyrics of her song "Girlfriend."
 The photos included a close-up of Lavigne and her unidentified partner holding the hand of their daughter, as well as a picture of the singer holding the baby clad in a leopard-print onesie. The final photo was befitting of the "Sk8er Boi" singer: a trio of black and white checkered Vans for each member of the family sitting on top of a skateboard.
 Lavigne's announcement came as a surprise for fans. The singer has been living out of the spotlight — and remaining inactive on social media — since concluding her "Greatest Hits Tour" in June 2025.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Although Lavigne didn't share details on her daughter or her partner, fans were quick to react to the news online.
 "Avril Lavigne disappearing for over a year and she comes back with baby," one fan wrote on X (formerly Twitter). This whole time I thought she was working on her next album, but honestly, this is such amazing news. I'm so happy for her!"
 Lavigne, pictured in 2024, recently welcomed her first child. (Getty Images)
 "I grew up watching her dominate the early 2000s in oversized ties and smudged eyeliner, completely rewriting the rules for girls who refused to fit into a polished pop box…," another said . "Watching the pop-punk princess officially welcome a mini princess of her own into the world is just pure magic."
 "I mean, I've heard of artists dropping a surprise album, but Avril Lavigne dropping a surprise baby is taking it to the next level," one person wrote. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Lavigne has spoken in the past about her desire to have a family. In November 2013, the singer, who was married to Nickelback singer Chad Kroeger at the time, told reporters she wanted to have children "eventually."
 "I want one or two [kids], but not right now. Like, in the future. Eventually," the then 29-year-old said . "I still need to just have fun!"
